revenue_scope: Avycaz net revenues, entirely in the US General Medicine segment
geography: U.S. (US General Medicine segment; International column '-' in every segment table)

series_start_reason: Series starts 2015Q2, the first quarter with a printed Avycaz figure (5.4). The six months ended June 30, 2015 also print 5.4 in the prior-year column of the 2016Q2 release, so 2015Q1 is nil. No Allergan or Actavis document dating the U.S. launch was found (Avycaz does not appear in the 2015Q1-2015Q3 filings), so launch_quarter is null.
series_end_reason: Allergan plc was acquired by AbbVie on 2020-05-08 (see AbbVie filings); its last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2020-03-31 (filed 2020-05-07). AbbVie's 47 earnings-release exhibits from 2020-05-01 to 2026-10-05 and its 25 Forms 10-Q/10-K from 2020-06-30 to 2026-06-30 print no row for this brand (case-insensitive text search of each exhibit/main document).
notes: The 2015 quarters and 2016Q1 are prior-year columns because the own-quarter documents (2015 Forms 10-Q/10-K and releases, and the 2016Q1 release/10-Q) print no Avycaz row; from 2016Q2 each quarter is read from its own release (US General Medicine product revenue table for 2016Q2-2016Q3, segment table with a Total column from 2016Q4; 2020Q1 from the Form 10-Q). Full-year checks against the Q4 releases: 2015 22.6, 2016 36.1, 2017 61.2, 2018 94.6, 2019 116.7, all matching the sum of the four quarters.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K) for CIK 0001578845 (Actavis plc / Allergan plc), 0000038074 (Forest Laboratories) and 0000850693 (Allergan, Inc.) via data.sec.gov/submissions including the older 'files' pages; earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02 and their exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json.

Listed AbbVie (CIK 0001551152) filings: 25 Forms 10-Q/10-K from 2020-06-30 to 2026-06-30 and 47 item 2.02 earnings 8-Ks from 2020-05-01 to 2026-10-05 (every Exhibit 99 scanned, case-insensitive) searched for Aczone, Namenda, Viibryd, Fetzima and Avycaz: no earnings exhibit matches any; the 10-Q/10-K main documents match 'Namenda' (case-insensitive counts fall from 6 to 0 by the 2025Q2 filing; the matching passages were not read) and never match Aczone, Viibryd, Fetzima or Avycaz.
Avycaz rows read by table-row parsing of Allergan plc item 2.02 earnings exhibits 2016-08 to 2020-02, the 2016-2017 prior-year columns, and the Form 10-Q for 2020Q1.

Searched the 2015Q1, 2015Q2 and 2015Q3 Forms 10-Q and the 2015 Form 10-K for 'Avycaz' (case-insensitive text): 0 matches; the 2015Q1-2015Q4 releases have no table row beginning 'Avycaz'; the 2016 Form 10-K (agn-10k_20161231.htm) prints the 2015 total 22.6 in US General Medicine with every other segment nil.
Searched the same 2015 documents and the 2016Q2 Form 10-Q for a launch sentence naming Avycaz or ceftazidime: none, so no launch quarter is cited.
